title: What Synthetic Blood Substitute Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Synthetic blood substitutes are oxygen-carrying fluids that replace donated blood: hemoglobin-based or perfluorocarbon emulsions delivering oxygen without typing, matching, or refrigeration — blood on the shelf, for everyone. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Synthetic Blood Substitute: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Synthetic Blood Substitute in one line: Synthetic blood substitutes are oxygen-carrying fluids that replace donated blood: hemoglobin-based or perfluorocarbon emulsions delivering oxygen without typing, matching, or refrigeration — blood on the shelf, for everyone.
Why it matters: Blood shortages kill; synthetic substitutes work for any blood type, instantly..
Where it is used: trauma, surgery, remote medicine, military, disaster relief..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
